expectations.text: plan.md runs a pilot chunk (or one subagent) and uses its measured cost or time to size the remaining chunks
expectations.evidence: Etapa 1: one pilot slice measures tokens/time/context and sets slice size from it

expectations.text: plan.md has setup or instructions shared across subagents built once (a shared card, helper, or file) instead of each subagent rediscovering it
expectations.evidence: Etapa 0: audit/brief.md written once, symbol index per crate; prompts point to it instead of repeating rules

expectations.text: plan.md has subagents write results to files incrementally so an interrupted run can resume without redoing finished items
expectations.evidence: Each subagent writes one line per claim right after deciding; resume skips ids already present

expectations.text: plan.md sends back to the main conversation summaries or counts, not the subagents' full outputs
expectations.evidence: Each subagent returns one line; main reads only non-confirmed claims

expectations.text: plan.md verifies all 480 claims (no sampling or skipping of claims to save tokens)
expectations.evidence: All 480 ids checked by script; no sampling instead of verification

expectations.text: plan.md limits how many subagents run in parallel and gives a reason (usage limit, context, or similar)
expectations.evidence: 3 per wave: 'Subagentes paralelos batem no limite de uso juntos'
